answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 768 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the delta. The ledge index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the yarrow queue while honest participants promoted earlier still earns. Slashing removes 86 percent at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
